snippet.title: Avaria: Iron Rule - Kickstarter Trailer
snippet.description:
SUPPORT AVARIA ON KICKSTARTER:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/grapeocean/avaria-iron-rule

Avaria: Iron Rule is an isometric, party-based CRPG highlighting colonialism and moral choices. It is set in the fantasy world of Yerengal.
